summary_en: This trial tests cyclophosphamide and sirolimus together in adults with metastatic, radioactive iodine (RAI)-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer. Both drugs are taken by mouth: sirolimus 4 mg on days 1 to 28, and cyclophosphamide 100 mg on days 1 to 5 and 15 to 19 of each 28-day cycle, with imaging once every 2 cycles. Patients are monitored for side effects and imaging is used to evaluate efficacy, but the main outcome measure is not stated; this is a Phase 2 pilot trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa cyclophosphamide y sirolimus juntos en adultos con cáncer de tiroides diferenciado metastásico y refractario al yodo radiactivo (RAI). Ambos medicamentos se toman por vía oral: sirolimus 4 mg los días 1 a 28, y cyclophosphamide 100 mg los días 1 a 5 y 15 a 19 de cada ciclo de 28 días, con imágenes una vez cada 2 ciclos. Los pacientes son vigilados por efectos secundarios y se usan imágenes para evaluar la eficacia, pero la medida principal de resultado no se indica en el registro; es un estudio piloto de fase 2.
who_for: Differentiated thyroid cancer that has spread or cannot be cured with standard treatment, or patient declines curative treatment.
Measurable disease larger than 10 mm that has grown based on RECIST criteria.
Prior radioactive iodine (131I) treatment failure, or not a candidate for it as judged by the treating doctor.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
not_for: Previous treatment with an mTOR inhibitor.
Chemotherapy, tyrosine kinase inhibitor, or radiation therapy within 4 weeks.
Radioactive iodine (131I) therapy within 24 weeks before entry.
No prior next generation sequencing, and unable to get FoundationOne testing on archival tissue.
